hints.tr: `RUN a && b && c` biçiminde; silme de aynı satırda.
hints.en: In the form `RUN a && b && c`; the delete on the same line too.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**Dockerfile**

```dockerfile
FROM alpine:3.22
RUN head -c 30000000 /dev/urandom > /tmp/cache.bin && \
    sha256sum /tmp/cache.bin | cut -c1-8 > /checksum.txt && \
    rm /tmp/cache.bin
CMD ["sh", "-c", "echo checksum ready && wc -c < /checksum.txt"]
```
hints.en:
